title: Crew asks $5, $10 or $25 with $10 suggested, and the supporter mark follows active support for 45 days
detail: PHASE 4 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). PWYW_CONFIG_DEFAULT presets 499/1000/2500, suggested 1000, and the catalog.pwyw row in production (suggested 2499 today, a migration). earnsSupporterMark stops reading the suggested amount: any active Crew earns it, fading 45 days after support stops. Picker copy: one impact line, a dignified "not right now", "contribute what you want" (ADR-1084). Shipped: PWYW_CONFIG_DEFAULT presets 499/1000/2500 with 1000 suggested, migration 20270346004200_crew_presets.sql merges the same into the stored catalog.pwyw row, earnsSupporterMark takes any valid Crew amount, and supporterMarkShows (the profile badge) shows on active Crew and fades 45 days after the canceled member event. The picker says contribute what you want, carries one impact line, three presets with $10 selected, and a Not right now link.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const c=r("lib/pricing/catalog-config.ts");const d=(c.split("PWYW_CONFIG_DEFAULT: PwywConfig = {")[1]||"").split("}")[0];if(!/suggestedCents:\s*1000/.test(d))fail("suggested is not 1000");if(!/presetCents:\s*\[499,\s*1000,\s*2500\]/.test(d))fail("presets are not 499/1000/2500");if(/suggestedCents/.test((c.split("export function earnsSupporterMark")[1]||"").split("\n}")[0]))fail("the supporter mark still keys off the suggested amount");if(!/45/.test(c))fail("no 45-day fade");console.log("ok: Crew presets and the fading mark are in")'
